home.heroTitle: A Timeless Cappadocia Sanctuary Carved Into Ancient Tuff Stone
home.heroDescription: Discover the enchanting spirit of Cappadocia in our vaulted cave suites and handcrafted stone rooms overlooking millennia-old valleys at sunrise.

story.title: The Memory of Stone, the Calm of the Guest
story.paragraph1: Cappadocia's millennia-old tuff rock breathes anew as a mansion. Every arch, niche, and stone surface was shaped by local craftsmen into the calm form it holds today.
story.paragraph2: In our rooms, the coolness of natural stone meets the warmth of hand-woven textiles. Days here change rhythm with the light rising over the valley and the crackle of a stone fireplace at dusk.
story.paragraph3: To stay here is to join Cappadocia's rhythm: slow, deep, and remembered.

experience.title: Four Ways to Feel Cappadocia
experience.intro: Details that turn your stay into an experience touching the very texture of the region.

shelter.title: A Sanctuary Within Stone
shelter.description: Living spaces restored with traditional Cappadocian masonry, each with its own distinct texture.

terrace.title: Valley Terrace & Balloon Views
terrace.description: Watch the sunrise balloons fill the sky with a cup of coffee beside the silence of the valley.

comfort.title: Carved Jacuzzi & Stone Fireplace
comfort.description: Leave the day's tiredness in your private jacuzzi carved into tuff rock, then complete the evening by the stone fireplace.

breakfast.title: Cappadocia Breakfast
breakfast.description: A long, unhurried morning that begins with village produce, homemade preserves, and fresh bread.

roomsCta.title: Rooms That Carry Their Own Story
roomsCta.body: Discover our collection, from arched cave suites to stone rooms overlooking the valley.

contact.title: In the Heart of Cappadocia
contact.body: A quiet location overlooking the valley within Nevşehir's historic texture. Contact our front desk for directions and stay enquiries.
